description: Execute an allowlisted Nextcloud OCC command on the server and return the output. Only command and argument combinations in the allowlist may be run (configurable via MCP_OCC_ALLOWLIST env var). The default allows read-only commands only: status, app:list, setupchecks, integrity:check-core, integrity:check-app, user:list, user:info and group:list with any arguments; update:check, maintenance:mode and theming:config without arguments.
name: run_occ
title: Run OCC Command
